name: Terran Confederation
description: A democratic coalition of core worlds. Values stability, law, and trade. The largest and most organized faction.

name: Iron Syndicate
description: A corporate military state run by an oligarchy of weapons manufacturers. Controls the most powerful fleet in known space.

name: Void Collective
description: Mysterious technocrats from the outer rim. Highly advanced technology but deeply isolationist. Few outsiders are welcomed.

name: Free Planets Alliance
description: A loose coalition of free traders, rebels, and frontier settlers. No central government. Strength in numbers.

name: Independent
description: Unaffiliated systems — frontier outposts, pirate havens, and forgotten colonies.
